findings.title: before_validation crashes on nil host
findings.body: In app/models/embeddable_host.rb the before_validation block calls self.host.sub! unconditionally. If host is nil or blank, this raises NoMethodError instead of failing validation. Any create/update with missing host param therefore 500s instead of returning a validation error.

findings.title: update crashes on unknown id
findings.body: In app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb update does EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first then calls save_host(host) without checking for nil. An unknown or deleted id causes NoMethodError on nil inside save_host instead of 404, resulting in a 500.

findings.title: destroy crashes on unknown id
findings.body: In app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb destroy does EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first then host.destroy without nil check. Requesting a non-existent id raises NoMethodError on nil instead of returning 404/success_json.

findings.title: Migration crashes when embed_category is blank
findings.body: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration does execute(... WHERE s.name='embed_category')[0]['id'].to_i. If embed_category setting is blank, missing, or does not match a category name, [0] is nil and the migration raises NoMethodError and cannot run. The fallback to uncategorized_category_id on line 14 is never reached.

findings.title: SQL injection and unnormalized hosts in migration
findings.body: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb line 25 interpolates raw site-setting value h directly into SQL: VALUES ('#{h}', ...). A host containing a quote breaks the statement or injects SQL; values should be quoted/escaped or inserted via ActiveRecord. It also inserts raw values with scheme/path intact, while EmbeddableHost normalizes to bare hostname, so migrated rows will not match EmbeddableHost.host_allowed? lookups.

findings.title: Host lookup is case-sensitive and drops ports
findings.body: In app/models/embeddable_host.rb record_for_host does where("lower(host) = ?", host) where host is uri.host without downcasing. Because only the column is lowered, lookups with uppercase letters miss, and because uri.host strips :port while the model validation allows and stores host:port, any host configured with a port can never match. Allowed referers are then incorrectly rejected.

findings.title: Fabricator files are swapped
findings.body: spec/fabricators/category_fabricator.rb now defines only Fabricator(:embeddable_host) while spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb defines Fabricator(:category) and related category fabricators. The contents are in the wrong files. It happens to load because all fabricators are required, but it breaks the file-to-fabricator convention and will confuse future maintenance or selective loading.

findings.title: _hydrateEmbedded assumes *_ids is always an array
findings.body: In app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/store.js.es6 _hydrateEmbedded calls obj[k].map for any key matching *_ids. If the value is null/undefined or a single scalar, this throws TypeError. When individual ids have no matching embedded record, _lookupSubType returns undefined, so the resulting plural array contains undefined entries instead of filtering them out.
